full_details: On the post by the Bull, two bills side by side, black-letter, title only. You read the Rose's first: the Lord Admiral's servants, The Grecian Comedy. Then your own: the Lord Chamberlain's servants, Fair Em, the corner already torn for a pipe-light. No author on either. You do not know what the Rose took. You are not cast. It is Friday, so fish, and you went back up to the desk. The messenger still enters on an empty half-line. Under it, the women give a twelvemonth and a day. You did not write the last line, and you did not write a song. You set down the rates you already live by, and you did not count the coffer. At the play's end you came down for a roll in Garnish's basket and found Edith Kettlewood with a mended doublet and eight shillings still owing from the autumn. Praise did not settle it. Heminges named Lady Day as the latest he can promise. Kemp said a prince who cannot pay for his sleeves should keep his arms inside his coat. She did not laugh until you had written the debt. It is not your debt. The new seam is finer than the old. The tables say Edith viij s. owing. Lady Day.
one_sentence: You read the Grecian Comedy and Fair Em on the bills, and wrote Edith's eight shillings.
title: Read two bills and wrote Edith's eight shillings
